# Data Source: catalyst_project_import_job

Experimental. Read the current status of an existing Catalyst IaC project import job. Requires Development, an explicit organization, and `ZohoCatalyst.project.import.READ`. Use the job ID from your CLI or console import. The resulting project ID is available once the job is Completed. Terraform performs a single lookup. Verified offline against the official CLI contract.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalyst_project_import_job" "example" {
  id = var.import_job_id
}

output "import_status" {
  value = data.catalyst_project_import_job.example.status
}

output "created_project_id" {
  value = data.catalyst_project_import_job.example.project_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `id` (String) Existing IaC import job ID as a positive numeric string.

## Attribute Reference

- `project_id` (String) Resulting project ID when status is Completed. Null while the job is pending or failed.
- `status` (String) Exact status reported by Catalyst, such as Scheduled, Processing, Completed or Error_Processing.
